He believes this would send a positive message about West Bengal's investment climate and erase the negative perception created after the Nano project was forced out of the state in 2008. recent_articles.title: Vidyasagar Setu Closed | Vidyasagar Setu to remain closed for eight hours on Sunday for repair work - Telegraph India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kolkata Police** announced an eight-hour closure of the Vidyasagar Setu bridge on Sunday, May 31st, from 6 am to 2 pm. **Hooghly River Bridge Commissioners Authority** will replace stay cables, holding down cables and bearings during the work.  Traffic diversions will be enforced on multiple routes leading to the bridge, with vehicles diverted to Howrah Bridge via various alternate roads. The repair work is part of ongoing maintenance for the city's second Hooghly bridge.

recent_articles.title: ‘Reminder of true cost of nation’s security’: Rajnath, Yogi inaugurate naval museum in Lucknow | Lucknow News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh** and **Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** inaugurated the 'Nausena Shaurya Vatika' naval museum in Lucknow. The open-air display showcases artifacts from INS Gomati, a decommissioned ship that served for 34 years.  The museum cost Rs 19 crore to build and features weapons systems, including an AK 726 naval gun and a TU 142M maritime patrol aircraft. **Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi**, Chief of the Naval Staff, was also present at the inauguration. The museum aims to inspire future generations about India's defense capabilities.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Cyberabad Municipal Corporation (CMC)** approved several infrastructure development projects at its 4th Ordinary Meeting. recent_articles.title: In 1997, India's ocean saved the monsoon from El Nino. This year, it won't - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD), a natural temperature imbalance in the Indian Ocean, typically helps India's monsoon season by pushing moisture-laden winds towards the subcontinent. This year, however, the IOD is flat and neutral, leaving India vulnerable to El Nino's potential impact on its monsoon rainfall.  El Nino, a warming of the Pacific Ocean that disrupts normal weather patterns, could lead to below-average monsoon rainfall in 2026, potentially impacting crop yields and food prices. The Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) has already lowered its forecast for the monsoon season, predicting it will be significantly below average.

recent_articles.title: Government unveils AI-enabled chatbot to help people lodge complaints - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Centre** on Saturday unveiled an AI-enabled chatbot named 'Samadhan Didi' to help citizens raise grievances against government departments online.  Union Minister of State for Personnel Jitendra Singh called the chatbot a "democratisation of public grievance mechanism" and highlighted its ability to simplify, make accessible, and provide multilingual support. Developed by the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) in collaboration with Bhashini, the chatbot is designed to automatically identify the appropriate Ministry, department, category, and sub-category for each grievance.  The chatbot was demonstrated live at the launch event and will be integrated into the CPGRAMS portal to reach citizens across India.

recent_articles.title: Haryana government has assured to maintain 1,000 cusecs of water supply through Munak Canal: Delhi CM | Delhi News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Haryana** Chief Minister Rekha Gupta assured that the state will supply 1,000 cusecs of water to **Delhi** daily through the Munak Canal.  The **Delhi Jal Board (DJB)** is currently producing around 900-924 cusecs of water per day, but faces a shortfall of over 300 MGD during peak summer. The DJB has been working to maintain production and ensure minimal disruption for residents, while also addressing complaints related to water scarcity. **Water Minister Parvesh Sahib Singh** highlighted the challenges posed by the low Yamuna water level at Wazirabad Barrage, but emphasized efforts to sustain water production.  The CM directed officials to address all water leakage complaints and deploy more tankers in affected areas.

recent_articles.title: BSF to get stronger security grid along borders: Amit Shah
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Amit Shah**, the Union Home Minister, praised the **BSF** for its service in safeguarding difficult borders over the past 60 years. He highlighted the harsh conditions faced by BSF personnel and emphasized the government's efforts to strengthen border security through advanced technology and infrastructure improvements.  Shah also announced the establishment of a center to educate citizens about BSF duties and the development of a "quadrangular security grid" for improved territorial security.

recent_articles.title: Mosque, temple and modernisation: Can Kolkata airport become world-class? - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sourav Sikdar**, the BJP MLA from Uttar Dum Dum, and **Rammohan Naidu Kinjarapu**, the Union civil aviation minister, have confirmed plans to relocate a mosque and a temple near Kolkata's Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport for its expansion. The relocation is part of a larger redevelopment project aimed at transforming the airport into a world-class facility with an Aerocity district similar to Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport.  The government aims to boost economic benefits for the surrounding region, particularly the Uttar Dum Dum municipality, which currently earns around Rs 86 lakh annually from airport operations. The relocation of the mosque and temple is part of ongoing discussions that have been raised in Parliament since 1998.

recent_articles.title: Thousands of farmers halt trains in Rajasthan as wheat procurement row escalates | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Thousands of farmers in Rajasthan's Hanumangarh district blocked the Bikaner–Hanumangarh railway track on Saturday, protesting against a reduced wheat procurement period and lower procurement targets. The protest escalated after farmers met with local officials who assured them that Hanumangarh would receive 8 lakh bags of wheat procurement capacity while neighboring Sriganganagar would receive 11 lakh bags.  The farmers' agitation is ongoing as they demand an extension to the procurement period and a higher target, citing increased wheat production in the district. The Indian Express reports on this story with coverage by Principal Correspondent Parul Kulshrestha.

recent_articles.title: Massive Sandstorm Engulfs Bikaner, A Sight Straight Out Of 'Dune' Universe
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A massive dust storm hit **Bikaner**, Rajasthan, on Saturday afternoon, causing severe visibility reduction and disrupting city life. The strong winds snapped tree branches, caused power outages, and led to panic among residents as the storm blanketed the city in a dense haze.  **The Meteorological Department** advised caution and urged residents to avoid unnecessary travel during adverse weather conditions.
